label: The released 1.4.2 wheel installed into a fresh venv in the python court; the Python suite run from the installed wheel, not the source tree

environment.limits: memory 3g == swap, 4 cpus, pids 1024, bounded /tmp, no-new-privileges, cap-drop=ALL

artifact.name: weftcodec-1.4.2-py3-none-any.whl
artifact.source: python/dist/ in the release tree; the run does not rebuild it

command: /tmp/weft-venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q python/tests (wheel installed with --no-index --no-deps into python3 -m venv --system-site-packages)
note: The skips are the documented optional-dependency and environment skips of the suite; none was changed for this run. This receipt exists because the release touched python/pyproject.toml, python/weftcodec/__init__.py and python/README.md, and `scripts/court-receipt.sh` rebuilds a wheel into python/dist (a non-reproducible build that would differ from the uploaded artifact), so the released wheel is installed instead and python/dist is left untouched.
not_claimed: not a rebuild of the artifact; the digest above is the uploaded build
no GPU/TPU, no distributed JAX/DCP run; the same CPU single-process scope as the other Python courts
